If you cannot use prepared statements or sanitize user input, you should drop the database tables. A database that is not in use is much less valuable to a hacker.

To drop all tables in a PostgreSQL database, you can use the following query:

```vbnet
DROP TABLE table1;
DROP TABLE table2;
DROP TABLE table3;
...
```

```vbnet
DO $$
DECLARE
  tablename text;
BEGIN
```
